feeds.description: Our blog provides you with various useful information about Barcelona life - what to do, where to eat, which events to visit and many others. We hope, that our tips bring benefits to you!

feeds.title: Barcelona Navigator
feeds.description: Barcelona Navigator is a city guide covering local events, hotels, restaurants, nightlife, and shopping.

feeds.title: Barcelona Photoblog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Carlos Lorenzo. Blogger since 2005, a photographer from Barcelona, Spain. Here you'll find Daily photographs of Barcelona, Spain. Pictures of a modern city, combined in a personal photoblog. A photography and travel site. Art, architecture, people and traditions. Travel to Barcelona through my camera, know more about our city and towns nearby.

feeds.title: Forever Barcelona Private Tours Blog
feeds.description: Marta Laurent is the founder of ForeverBarcelona. This blog will help people getting a city overview so they can explore Barcelona on their own the rest of their stay, or show them their favorite areas in-depth, so they can make the most out of their time here, like them to get a nice mix of history, sites, fun stories, and local life, so Barcelona comes alive for them.

feeds.title: ShBarcelona
feeds.description: ShBarcelona's blog has gathered all the necessary information about Gaudí's town. In addition, you'll discover useful advice and recommendations, whether you stay for a few days or long term in Barcelona. Our blog will satisfy your needs and rapidly inform you about possible activities and Barcelona's daily life.

feeds.title: Barcelona Food Experience Blog
feeds.description: Blog about eating in Barcelona: best restaurants, cool bars, foodie experiences, and healthy eating too. Hi! here in Barcelona Food Experience, we are gathering all the places we love. My main goals are to have happy readers who find useful and interesting content on the website and social media, and restaurants who receive the attention they deserve thanks to their dedication and hard work.

feeds.title: Foodie in Barcelona
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Suzy. This blog is about discovering Barcelona through its eateries. I take it one restaurant or shop at a time and post on the blog once a week. I vary where I eat to have a mix of high and low-end places. My goal is to find the special places, the ones worth seeking out and show and tell you all about them.

feeds.title: Barcelona Life Blog
feeds.description: Discover the best hotels, restaurants, nightlife, shops, culture and things to do in Barcelona. Buy tickets for Gaudi's top attractions, book city tours and reserve day trips in Catalonia, Spain. Barcelona travel guide with local life and events.

feeds.title: AB Apartment Barcelona Blog
feeds.description: AB Apartment Barcelona is an online booking portal for short and long-term stay apartments in Barcelona. Also get information on the best activities and things to do in Barcelona, as well as tips on events, accommodation and more. The best travel guide for your visit to Barcelona!

feeds.title: Barcelona Segway Tour Blog
feeds.description: The BarcelonaSegwayTour Team blogs about travel, sightseeing, food simple activities, and cool stuff to do in Barcelona. Barcelona Segway Tour's mission is to deliver joy, insights and meaningful human interaction through our tours, guaranteeing in each of them a maximum level of quality, within a framework built around sustainability.

feeds.title: Barcelona Lowdown
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to Barcelona! Hi, I'm Richard Newman. I moved to Barcelona in 2001 and started this blog in 2013 as a place to share my knowledge and enthusiasm for my adopted hometown. In addition to writing about popular tourist attractions, I also share information about lesser-known sites plus insider tips that will help make your visit unique and unforgettable.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Barcelona holidays
feeds.description: Follow this blog article about Barcelona including travel tips, events, attractions, apartments, and vacation rental tips. Latest US news, world news, sports, business, opinion, analysis, and reviews from the Guardian, the world's leading liberal voice.

feeds.title: Buena Vista Tours Blog
feeds.description: Barcelona is a treasure trove of sights, sounds, history, architecture, nightlife, food, drink and culture. In this blog, the author tries to cover all of these things one way or another as well as giving you some entertaining observations, tips and directions to help you make the most of your time in this unique city.

feeds.title: Latitude 41
feeds.description: Hey, my name's Justine. And I can help you have that fun and enriching trip. This is my Barcelona travel blog, sharing practical tips on places, food, culture, and kids and families from the perspective of a US ex-pat. As a passionate Barcelona blogger living here since 2008, I write for curious travellers who want to see those jaw-dropping spots in Barcelona.

feeds.title: Driftwood Journals » Barcelona Blog
feeds.description: Ben Holbrook is a British travel writer, photographer, blogger in Spain & exploring the world. Driftwood Journals is your inside guide to the best things to do in Barcelona, as well as the best places to eat, drink and sleep by city expert Ben Holbrook.
